description: Source code for Bluetooth networking support in Zephyr OS, including Bluetooth connection management, L2CAP handling, scanning, advertising, and data transmission.

classes.name: bt_if_conn
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth interface connection, including network interface, L2CAP channel, and addresses.

classes.name: bt_context
classes.description: Holds array of active Bluetooth connections.

methods.name: net_bt_recv
methods.description: Handles incoming Bluetooth packets, decompresses IPv6 data, and passes it to the network stack.

methods.name: net_bt_get_conn
methods.description: Retrieves the connection associated with a network interface.

methods.name: net_bt_send
methods.description: Compresses IPv6 packets and sends them over Bluetooth L2CAP channel.

methods.name: net_bt_enable
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth interface (stub implementation).

methods.name: net_bt_flags
methods.description: Returns L2 layer flags for the Bluetooth interface.

methods.name: bt_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes Bluetooth network interface, assigns it to connection slots, and sets dormant state.

methods.name: ipsp_connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth L2CAP connection establishment, sets addresses, and updates neighbor cache.

methods.name: ipsp_disconnected
methods.description: Handles disconnection events, sets interface to dormant.

methods.name: ipsp_recv
methods.description: Receives data over L2CAP, creates network packet, and passes to network stack.

methods.name: ipsp_alloc_buf
methods.description: Allocates buffer for incoming L2CAP data.

methods.name: bt_advertise
methods.description: Starts or stops Bluetooth advertising based on request.

methods.name: bt_connect
methods.description: Initiates Bluetooth connection to a device.

methods.name: device_found
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth device discovery, filters connectable devices.

methods.name: bt_active_scan
methods.description: Starts active Bluetooth scanning.

methods.name: bt_passive_scan
methods.description: Starts passive Bluetooth scanning.

methods.name: bt_scan_off
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth scanning.

methods.name: bt_scan
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth scan requests (on, passive, off).

methods.name: bt_disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Callback for successful Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Callback for Bluetooth disconnection.
